title: Digital Subscription & Account Sprawl
dataSources: Breach alerts (`breach:alert`), inbox stats (`inbox:stats`), cloud-drive usage (`clouddrive:usage`), certificate expiry (`certexpiry:check`).
app: Personal cybersecurity feeds — Have-I-Been-Pwned breach alerts, personal email/inbox stats, cloud-storage usage APIs, and personal TLS-certificate expiry checks — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=breach:alert event=account_inventory
| stats count as accounts, sum(eval(if(last_used_days>365,1,0))) as dormant by category
| sort - dormant
description: Counts your online accounts and how many are dormant, prompting you to close the ones you no longer use.
value: Every unused account is attack surface; pruning them shrinks your exposure and your digital clutter.
implementation: Maintain an account inventory in `index=personal`; count dormant accounts by category.
visualization: Bar chart of dormant accounts by category.
grandmaExplanation: It counts your online accounts and how many you no longer use, so you can close the old ones.
